data.one_liner: A pure Dart popup menu widget for iOS and Android.
data.what_it_does: PopupMenu provides a customizable context menu that can be shown at a specific rect or widget key. It supports custom icons, text styles, and callbacks for clicks, show, and dismiss events.
use_when: You need a lightweight, platform‑agnostic popup menu without external dependencies.
You want to customize the menu items’ appearance and behavior directly in code.
avoid_when: You require advanced animations or gesture handling beyond basic show/hide.
You need a fully featured menu system with built‑in actions like navigation or state management.
strengths: Pure Dart implementation, no native code or platform channels.
Easy to integrate: just set PopupMenu.context and call show().
Highly customizable: background, line color, max columns, item icons, text styles.
weaknesses: No built‑in animation support; show/hide is instant.
Limited feature set; no nested menus or complex interactions.
Last major update was in 2022; may lack recent Flutter improvements.
data.setup_notes: Set PopupMenu.context = context; then create and show the menu.
